text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Thank you very much for traveling 
all this way with me today.
choice_data_list:
You're welcome, it was Chrono's dearest 
wish after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Whenever I am in a slump, I always find 
myself wanting to pray at this shrine...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's considered optimal for recovering 
from illness, injury, and slumps, and it 
is a historic site that even legendary 
Umamusume have visited to pray, so—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"An eternal idol, and a legendary 
Umamusume who left her mark on the 
racetrack as well— it's Haiseiko!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In the Monthly Twinkle interview, you 
mentioned receiving blessings in both 
careers... and—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh. So this is the shrine that took care 
of you.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Whenever I wasn't feeling well... but 
had a concert or race I couldn't give up 
on, it always gave me that extra push.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Haiseiko-san... and Speed Symboli-san...!?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It is such a serene and charming place. 
The air is so crisp and clear—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Even St. Lite...! T-To think all these 
legendary Umamusume are gathered 
together...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you from the Central Tracen 
Academy?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. It's Chrono Genesis...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It is an honor to make your acquaintance. 
Um...—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Since I have finished offering my prayers, 
I shall take my leave now. I'll make 
myself scarce so as not to get in the way.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for being so polite. 
...Tell me, what is your dream?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Going so far as to pray to the gods to 
blow away this slump... You came here 
because there's a dream you want to 
fulfill, right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I, well, um――

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to follow in everyone's footsteps 
and become an Umamusume who weaves 
history...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The countless great achievements of those 
who built racing history, starting with 
those three. Moved by their thrilling 
drama, I too hope that one dayâ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I am still inexperienced right now, but 
one day, I'll carve my name into racing 
history...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Good eyes.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You can achieve it. I have a feeling... 
you will follow right behind me.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Your resolve has been heard loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
In the name of St Lite, I bless your 
future... and the history you will weave.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: I'm rooting for you, future superstar♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entrusted with the future by a great 
predecessor, she seemed overwhelmed to her 
limits, but thanks to a fortunate 
encounter, her spirits were restored.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's considered optimal for recovering 
from illness, injury, and slumps, and it 
is a historic site that even legendary 
Umamusume have visited to pray, so—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“It might be an impure motive, but I'm 
still happy to be able to visit like 
this.”
choice_data_list:
I'd love to hear more stories about this 
place and the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Gladly...! I have my notes right here 
summarizing the anecdotes about this 
shrine and Umamusume—wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize for the trouble I've 
caused.
choice_data_list: I'm glad we found the memo

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Maybe visiting with impure motives 
was a bad idea...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis was utterly disheartened, 
and her condition remained off even after 
that.
